chunks.arabic_text: وَسَأَلَ عَلِيُّ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، أَخَاهُ مُوسَى بْنَ جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلَامُ:

translations.en: And ʿAlī ibn Jaʿfar asked his brother Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar عليهما السلام:

chunks.arabic_text: عَنْ رَجُلٍ أَعْطَى عَبْدَهُ عَشَرَةَ دَرَاهِمَ عَلَى أَنْ يُؤَدِّيَ الْعَبْدُ كُلَّ شَهْرٍ عَشَرَةَ دَرَاهِمَ أَيَحِلُّ ذَلِكَ

translations.en: about a man who gave his servant ten dirhams on the condition that the servant would pay ten dirhams every month. Is that permissible?
He said: "There is no harm in that."

en.summary: This hadith records a legal question posed to Imam Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar عليه السلام about giving money to a servant under a repayment arrangement. The Imam عليه السلام answers that there is no harm in it, indicating permissibility in this specific financial case.
en.seo_question: Is it permissible for a man to give his servant money with a condition of monthly repayment?

key_terms.عَبْدَهُ: his servant or slave in the legal context of the report
key_terms.عَشَرَةَ دَرَاهِمَ: ten dirhams, the stated amount of money
key_terms.كُلَّ شَهْرٍ: every month, indicating a recurring payment period
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm; it is permissible
